sources.snippet: MultitaskAI_Unity is an experimental Unity-based project designed to simulate an intelligent, multitasking AI system in a live game environment. Inspired by VTuber AI models like Neuro-sama, this project integrates real-time Twitch chat interaction, voice command recognition, and in-game control logic into a cohesive framework suitable for interactive entertainment or AI research.
